Ramon Spectre, an assassin, wakes up in a snowy yard. He has been knocked out and can't remember a thing. He reads "GM Siberian department" on a nearby wall.

Ramon was contracted by an anonymous customer to kill five Ground Member terrorist bosses. Falkov Mole, Ramon's sidekick, has gathered a file of the targets. The first one is right there in Mexico, Ramon's home country.
Ramon Spectre wanders through the deep jungles of Indonesia. GM does not like publicity and its bases are well hidden.
Falkov calls Ramon's headset radio. A GM security manager is testing the Indonesian department hardware. This is the perfect opportunity...
Ramon has infiltrated a Ground Member base in Sudan. GM is having a secret meeting here.
Ramon and Falkov feel the chill of Siberia. They've been lucky to reach the courtyard of a GM high-security installation.
Ramon is in a GM jail cell. He should not have trusted Natalia. I wonder if Falkov is still alive? GM was a peace defender and Ramon has to get out to set the record straight.
Ramon is loading up his new guns. He knows the sites of the Lone Wolf bases and Natalia's accent hinted that she came from Venezuela. Let's go get that map back!
GM is paying for retrieving the map and removing the LW boss. They are now convinced Ramon has changed sides and will co-operate from now on.
Only the LW general remains. Ramon feeds the coordinates to GM and they'll assemble a strike force.

Pleased with himself, Ramon returns to his secret lair. He admits being too trusting of Falkov and Natalia, but is also smiling for the first time in years. He faced his past, kicked its butt and saved the world on the side. To get more money, full energy or to skip levels try this cheat code: 13975.
